title: Introducing the Sakana AI Applied Research Lab
summary: （＊日本語は英文の後に） Today we are announcing the Sakana AI Applied Research Lab, a research group within Sakana AI that applies the company’s research to large, complex real-world systems, advancing the state of the art in their understanding and delivering it as value to Sakana AI clients. The Lab’s first program is in finance and economics. We expect other programs to emerge in the future. A complex system, such as a market or an economy, is not something one LLM-powered agentic AI can resolve. A complex phenomenon must be modeled as a system: its units, their links, and how changes in one part affect the others. Deciding which questions to ask, what to model, and how to judge the answers has been the work of human experts, and progress has run at the speed of human effort. Agentic AI can now implement, test, and refine models at scale; its weakness is knowing which questions matter. Combining the two, the potential of AI on top of a foundation of human knowledge, will be the focus of the Lab. Our First Program Finance has traditionally studied asset prices, and economics the larger system beneath them. AI connects the two at the granularity of firms and transactions, and in near real time: asset prices become the visible reflection of the economy. The Lab’s Computational Finance and Economics (COFE) program is interested in both: the visible portion and the real economy underneath.
